title: Vegan Mac and Cheese - Love and Lemons
description: The BEST vegan mac and cheese recipe! With a creamy, cheesy sauce made from sweet potatoes and nutritional yeast, it's just as good as the real thing.
notes: The sauce can be made days in advance; just cook and coat the pasta when you're ready to eat. Best served fresh, though leftovers can be reheated. For a smoky twist, blend 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika into the sauce, or stir in crumbled tempeh bacon bits. For spicy mac and cheese, puree the sauce with 1 tablespoon pickled jalapeños or a chipotle pepper from a can of chipotles in adobo. You can swap the sweet potato for an equal amount of diced carrot or butternut squash. For gluten-free, use your favorite gluten-free pasta (brown rice elbow macaroni works well). Add extra veggies like thawed frozen peas, spinach, or steamed broccoli for a bright pop of green. If broiling with breadcrumb topping, broil for just a few minutes until browned on top; the sauce gets less creamy if baked for too long. For a less sweet version, add more salt to balance. For a tangier version, adjust the apple cider vinegar and nutritional yeast to taste.

steps.text: Place {i1} and {i2} in a saucepan and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Add a few pinches of salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, until fork-tender, 8 to 12 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and transfer to a high-speed blender with {i3}, {i4}, {i5}, {i6}, {i7}, {i8}, {i9}, and {i10}. Blend until smooth.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Prepare {i11} according to the package instructions, cooking until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta cooking water before draining.
Drain and transfer the pasta back to the pot. Stir in the vegan cheese sauce, adding up to 1/2 cup pasta water to loosen the sauce, as necessary. Season to taste with {i12} and serve.
